items.reason: Header precedes the status table and names the set, resolved Runtime path, and binding kind.
Whole-set setup prints the header regardless of invocation location.
Canonical invocation and Runtime paths determine whether the “invoked from” line appears.
Routing carries BoundDefault into the binding-recorded announcement.
The old conditional bound-checkout message is removed.
Single-task AFK execution prints the current-checkout path without a Drain header.
The current-checkout line prints before the single-task HITL branch.
Successful whole-set execution prints one green done result.
Commit SHA or verified no-op detail prints beneath the done result.
The old completion printer is removed, with mutually exclusive result-printing branches.
Retry exhaustion that fails the task prints one red failed result.
Provider exhaustion preserves the open task and prints the distinct red left-open result.
Quota parking prints a yellow quota-paused result naming the selected preset.
Interrupted execution maps to the yellow interrupted result.
Blocked and Deferred remain set-level reports; executed tasks retain their own results.
Attempt narration and exhaustion breakdown remain; successful attempt timing follows the result.
Both output helpers preserve complete lines and suppress ANSI for redirected output.
Result lines use the existing terminal-color helper, which honors NO_COLOR.
Header and result helpers write output without adding journal records.

scores.rationale: Clear, focused implementation with useful tests; HITL, interruption, and Blocked/Deferred output integration coverage remains limited.
